The '''Commissars of Grizmallt''' were an organization<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> that shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Commissars of Grizmallt ordered industrial [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers to bolster the competition against [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="CCS" />
